messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API request queue length in us-west has exceeded 20k and p99 latency > 40s for /v1/generate. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit pool cap. Auto-escalation sent. See metrics: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted-queues

sre-michelle: Acknowledged. I'm paged. grabbing logs and starting triage. can someone post gpu pool status? :eyes:

eng-ryan: I'm here. GPU utilization on hosted-gpu-usw-1 is 98-100% across nodes. Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to provision new instances: quota limits in cloud account and node boot errors.

oncall-jordan: Taking primary oncall. Handoff: I have runbooks open (runbooks/hosted-queue-surge.md). Current impact: significant p95/p99 latency and timeouts for public API, some 503s. I'm going to enable soft-throttling on free-tier to reduce noisy traffic while we probe.

eng-sam: Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) route enterprise customers to reserved capacity (priority routing), 2) enable fallback to smaller quantized model variant for non-enterprise, 3) enable Request-Reject with Retry-After for overload. I can flip model fallback quickly if we have consensus.

pm-luis: We need to protect paying customers first. Which customers are hitting errors? support-ashley, can you make a quick list?

support-ashley: On it. Querying support logs now. Initial filter shows 3 Enterprise orgs with elevated errors: AcmeHealth, Ledgerly, BrightAds. I'll message account reps and offer status.

infra-elaine: Autoscaler failures show cloud quota limit error: "InsufficientAcceleratorQuota: requested 4 GPUs, but allowed 2". Also seeing repeated kubelet images pull timeout for new nodes. Likely two independent issues: quota and image registry flakiness.

eng-ryan: For quick relief I can switch default hosted model for new requests to redwood-small-q4 (quantized 4-bit) which reduces GPU memory and increases throughput. This will degrade quality slightly but massively cuts token time. Recommend enabling for 5-10 minutes while we clear backlog.

oncall-jordan: Do it. Also enable priority routing so enterprise traffic hits dedicated pools unaffected. Command I'll run:

```
# enable fallback model for hosted route
redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate --fallback-model=redwood-small-q4 --region=us-west
# enable priority routing for enterprise tag
redwoodctl routing set-priority --tag=enterprise --pool=dedicated-usw
```

eng-sam: Running the fallback switch now. Switching traffic.

incident-bot: ACTION: Route update applied. Started shifting 60% of ephemeral traffic to redwood-small-q4.

sre-michelle: After the fallback, queue length dropped from 28k -> 9k over 4 minutes, p95 down from ~18s -> 4.2s, p99 down from ~46s -> 12.8s. Good improvement but still some backlog. :thumbsup:

eng-ryan: I'm going to temporarily bump per-account throttles for free-tier to 20rps -> 5rps to reduce noisy clients. Will also activate soft reject header so SDKs can implement backoff.

```
# soft throttle
redwoodctl limits update --plan=free --rate=5
# enable overload reject header
redwoodctl feature-flags enable overload-reject
```

support-ashley: Notifying AcmeHealth and Ledgerly via email and in-app. Sent initial status and ETA.

infra-elaine: I've opened a quota increase request with Cloud Support for GPU accelerators, reference CS-47821. Meanwhile I'll try to provision nodes in another region and bring up cross-region routing. If us-west new nodes fail, we can burst to us-east.

eng-sam: Cross-region burst enabled to us-east. Route surge traffic with low priority, keep enterprise pinned to dedicated. Command:

```
redwoodctl routing add-burst --from-region=us-west --to-region=us-east --capacity=2000
```

sre-michelle: Handoff time approaching. Jordan, can you take notes and then hand to Ryan for oncall coverage? I'll stay on until we confirm backlog cleared below 1k.

oncall-jordan: Taking notes. Current mitigations applied:
- Fallback to redwood-small-q4 enabled for hosted default
- Enterprise priority routing to dedicated pools enabled
- Free-tier soft throttles reduced to 5rps
- Cross-region burst to us-east enabled
- Support notified for top customers

oncall-jordan: I'm handing off primary to eng-ryan in 15 minutes. Ryan, are you good to take over monitoring and postmortem lead?

eng-ryan: I can take it. I'll also triage autoscaler logs and follow up on quota request. After we stabilize, we should roll a temporary patch to make the autoscaler degrade gracefully when quota is hit (fallback to less GPUs per node) to avoid hard failures.

sre-michelle: Queue now at ~700 and trending down. p95 ~3.9s, p99 ~8.6s. Timeouts reduced significantly. Marking impact as mitigated for now. We'll keep monitoring for 60 minutes and then close the page.

pm-luis: Thanks everyone. Please prepare a short customer-facing status post for the affected accounts and a postmortem with timeline and action items.

eng-ryan: Will own postmortem. Initial action items:
- Improve autoscaler handling of quota errors (fallback mode)
- Add registry retry/backoff for node boot to mitigate image pull flakiness
- Automate priority routing to reserved pools for enterprise customers during overload
- Revisit free-tier throttling defaults and set dynamic backpressure rules

support-ashley: Customer updates sent. AcmeHealth asked for SLA credit assessment. Logging the request.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident marked mitigated by sre-michelle at 1853460200. Postmortem requested.

eng-sam: Quick logs excerpt from autoscaler showing quota failure:
```
E0321 12:07:31 autoscaler.go:214] ProvisionNode failed: InsufficientAcceleratorQuota: requested=4 allowed=2
Stacktrace: ...
```

infra-elaine: Cloud quota increase approved for 10 additional GPUs (CS-47821) but region limit propagation may take ~30m. Will monitor.

oncall-jordan: Handing off to eng-ryan now. Incident thread will remain open for postmortem notes. Ryan taking primary. :white_check_mark:

eng-ryan: Taking over. I'll coordinate draft postmortem and schedule retrospective tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Thanks all for fast actions.

sre-michelle: Closing monitoring watch in 45m unless new alerts. Great runbook execution. Postmortem owners: eng-ryan, infra-elaine, sre-michelle.

support-ashley: Will follow up with customers about next steps and SLA credit process.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: Mitigation confirmed, monitoring period started. Please create postmortem doc: /incidents/postmortems/1853456789-hosted-backlog-handoff.md
